Amazing Food, Amazing Service
Dec 2025 • Family
We had an excellent experience at iSteak. We ordered the ribeye and tenderloin, both grilled to perfection — honestly better than some steakhouses we’ve tried in the U.S. We also ordered two pastas, which were amazing, especially the carbonara. The garlic butter shrimp was another standout, full of flavor and perfectly cooked. Every single dish we had, including the sides, was delicious. Everything tasted incredibly fresh and well executed. On top of that, the service was excellent and they were able to accommodate us last minute. Highly recommend — we’ll definitely be back.

Prime ribs in a prime location!
Oct 2025 • Couples
If you are looking for a premium steak, look no further than this restaurant. Being Aussie’s, we are very fussy about the way our meat is cooked but iSTEAKS did not disappoint. We shared the OP rib which was cooked to perfection and oh so tasty. We had a glass or two of the house wines which were surprisingly very good. The staff were fantastic - the service was attentive and friendly. Along with a great view overlooking the street and town square, we had a lovely evening. So much so, that we went back and did it all again on our last night in HCMC. (Everything was excellent the second time around too!!). Highly recommend!!

Wonderfully cooked and well rested steak. Fabulous and attentive service.
Aug 2025 • Family
Fantastic food and steak. Expertly cooked. Steak is a favourite of ours and we cook at home a lot. This was expertly cooked and more importantly well rested. We had medium rare and it came as such. Party of 11 and all the food came at the same time. Staff very attentive and friendly. Very welcoming to foreigners and locals alike. If you would like a fabulous steak (better than we have had in the UK, France and the US) then look no further.
